meta.planning_lock:
PLANNING LOCK (hard — plan OVER clusters, then write JSON):
- Fill ALL 3 days (nights=2). No empty/partial days.
- Mandatory destinations (preferredRegions + mustVisit): (none). Plan ONLY in these areas — any other cluster is reference material, not a day.
- Destination→cluster map: (none)
- Day→cluster route (one day per cluster, in this order): D1:C0/Balqa Governorate · museums, religious_sites → D2:C1/Karak Governorate · museums, religious_sites → D3:C2/Tafilah Governorate · museums
- mustVisit entity lock: (none)
- Each day draws its POIs, meals and hotel from ITS OWN cluster.
- No entity twice in the whole trip: a POI or restaurant used on one day cannot reappear on another, and lunch and dinner are different places. Two days in the same city are two different clusters — use each cluster's own entities.
- Each day: 3 sights + lunch + dinner (5 entries, 6 max). Two sights only when the cluster has no third worth visiting, and say so. No gap over 90 minutes, no site under 45 minutes, at least 4 hours of sightseeing per full day.
- activity_alternatives come from that cluster's UNUSED entities: never an entity scheduled elsewhere in the trip, and never two scheduled stops as each other's swap.
- One visit, one fee (POIs within 600 m are parts of one site): C0: Fuheis Cultural Centre + Fuheis Heritage Quarter (Al-Fuheis Old Town); C0: Abu Jaber Museum + Al-Salt Latin Church and Convent + As-Salt Heritage Trail Starting Point; C1: Karak Archaeological Museum + St. George's Greek Orthodox Church + Al-Karak Heritage Village; C2: Tafilah Museum + Tafilah Municipal Park; C2: Dana Biosphere Reserve Visitor Center + Dana Village + Dana Biosphere Reserve + Dana Community Handicraft Workshop + Dana Eco-Tourism Camp
- Lodging requested: rating=4 star, type=hotel. Per-night base (night N = where day N ends): N1(C0): Grand East Hotel Resort & Spa Dead Sea [4-star]; N2(C1): Cairwan Hotel [2-star] (4-star unavailable in this area — say it is 2-star)
- Money: 700 JOD covers 5 traveller(s) for 3 days (≈233.333 JOD/day for the whole party). Lodging = nightly rate x 2 night(s) x ~3 room(s), arithmetic shown in the notes. aiPriority= → keep picks proportionate to the stated budget. SME=(none).
- Entry fees are the last thing to cut: never skip a named destination's main ticketed site to save money, and state what is left of the budget.
- Names/hours/fees: EntityCards only. If a card does not carry a fact (rating, booking requirement, closing day), do not state it.
- Prices: use the card value as-is, multiplied by the party size, and show the arithmetic in the tip ("10 JOD x 4"). If a card has no price, estimate from pricing_level and label it "~N JOD (estimated)".
- Events are reference only: never schedule them in the itinerary or budget.

geographic.clustering_rule: Keep each day geographically coherent. Avoid unnecessary cross-country hops.

budget.guidance: Balance comfort and value. Use dataset prices only when present.

climate.typical_pattern: High daytime heat, especially in the Jordan Valley and desert.
climate.outdoor_guidance: Walk outdoors in the morning. Keep the afternoon for shade, meals, or indoor visits.

decisions.title: Each day stays in one area
decisions.why: Mixing far-apart cities in one day makes the trip exhausting and confusing.
decisions.effect: Your days follow Karak (2 days), then Tafilah.

decisions.title: A route built around your interests
decisions.why: You didn't pick regions, so the days follow religious_sites, museums.
decisions.effect: Instead of staying only in the arrival city, the journey goes to Karak (2 days), then Tafilah.

decisions.title: This trip stays in one part of Jordan
decisions.why: 3 exploring days is too short for both the north and the south.
decisions.effect: So this journey focuses on the south, and those places get proper time.

decisions.title: Your first night is near the airport
decisions.effect: Night one is a hotel in Amman. Exploring starts from there the next day.

decisions.title: Amman for the first night, then south
decisions.why: You land at Queen Alia, and the exploring days are in Southern Jordan.
decisions.effect: Stay in Amman on arrival night, then travel south the next day.

decisions.title: Arrive, rest, then a short same-city plan
decisions.effect: About an hour for food, several hours of rest, then whatever daylight is left nearby — not a long drive.

decisions.title: Day trips from one hotel
decisions.why: These places are close enough to visit and return the same day.
decisions.effect: You keep the same hotel in Karak and come back there to sleep.

decisions.title: Then you move closer to the places you came for
decisions.why: Sleeping in the same city you visit beats a long commute every morning.
decisions.effect: After the arrival night, nearby days share one hotel. You only move when the next area is too far for a day trip.

decisions.title: Mornings for the outdoors
decisions.why: High daytime heat, especially in the Jordan Valley and desert.
decisions.effect: Walk heritage and nature in the morning. Save museums, meals, and shade for the afternoon.

decisions.title: A balanced pace
decisions.effect: About 3 places to visit and 3 meals on exploring days. The arrival day follows the time that remains after food and rest.

decisions.title: 4 star stays
decisions.effect: Hotels are taken from listings at that star level when the city has them. If it does not, we use the closest listed tier and say so.

decisions.title: A moderate budget
decisions.effect: A mix of comfortable and good-value stays and meals, with listed prices only.

decisions.title: Chosen around what you care about
decisions.effect: Sights, meals, and local hosts are matched to these. Unrelated places stay out.
